identity: A plain leather waist belt with a small metal buckle. Top and bottom edges are the wearer's own waistline and low-waist curves, so it sits flush at the natural waist on any body — no free vertices except the buckle.

regions.note: band. 0 fits torso.waistline (left to right, top edge); 1 fits torso.low_waist reversed (right to left, bottom edge). "over": ["leg_near"] puts it in the same late draw-rank as a shirt/pants hem so it shows over them, not just the bare torso.
